name: Deed
what: The signed instrument that conveys the property to the buyer, recorded in the county records.

fields.label: Deed type
fields.definition: General warranty, special warranty, without warranty, or quitclaim. Read it from the granting and warranty clauses, not only the heading: what the grantor promises about title, against all persons, only against claims through the grantor, or nothing.

fields.label: Grantor
fields.definition: The seller conveying title, exactly as named; compare it with the owner of record on the title commitment.

fields.label: Grantee
fields.definition: The buyer receiving title, with its entity type and state; compare it with the buyer in the contract and the insured on the title policy.

fields.label: Grantee's mailing address
fields.definition: The mailing address the deed gives for the grantee, which the county and tax offices use for notices.

fields.label: Date of deed
fields.definition: The date the deed states, and the date of each signature if different.

fields.label: Consideration recited
fields.definition: The consideration the deed recites, usually a nominal sum and other value; the price itself rarely appears.

fields.label: Legal description
fields.definition: The land conveyed, as described in the deed or its exhibit; compare it word for word with the commitment and the survey.

fields.label: Conveyed subject to
fields.definition: The matters the deed conveys the property subject to, such as recorded easements and restrictions, current taxes and tenants' rights; compare them with Schedule B of the title policy.

fields.label: Reservations
fields.definition: Anything the grantor keeps, such as minerals, an access easement or a right of first refusal.

fields.label: Vendor's lien retained
fields.definition: Whether the deed retains a lien for unpaid purchase money, in favor of the seller or of a lender that funded the purchase.

fields.label: Acknowledgment
fields.definition: The notary's certificate: who acknowledged and in what capacity, the date, the county and state, and whether it was taken in person or online.

fields.label: Recording information
fields.definition: The county, the instrument or document number and the recording date, once recorded.
